snippet.title: Skye's Repose Trailer
snippet.description:
Open the Gates.  Bring hope to the lonely and hurting.
Discover the secrets of Skye, a mysterious world of islands in the clouds.  Taking inspiration from Stardew Valley and Myst, explore, farm, meet mages in other realms, and solve the mysteries of the Garden of Skye in this cozy exploration game.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4061790/Skyes_Repose/
Or support me on Patreon, and join the alpha tests: https://www.patreon.com/Jimlad
